Rule provides for consideration of H.R. 5099 with 1 hour of general debate. Previous question shall be considered as ordered except motion to recommit. Measure will be read by section. Bill is open to amendments. It shall be in order to consider the committee amendment in the nature of a substitute recommended by the Committee on Interior and Insular Affairs now printed in the bill as an original bill and all points of order against said substitute shall be waived. It shall be in order to consider en bloc the amendments numbered 1 printed in the report accompanying this resolution and said amendments shall not be subject to a division of the question in the House or in the Committee of the Whole. All points of order against amendments No. 2 and 3 printed in the report for failure to comply with clause 7, rule XVI are waived.
